clips.title: The story
paras: Hostile leper gnomes and corrupted machines hold Launch Bay, deep in Gnomeregan beyond the Hall of Gears. The underground airfield once served gnomish flying machines and bombers; now the city’s former hangar is under enemy control.

Launch Bay’s two tiers once housed Gnomeregan’s aerial fleet. Ramps from the upper walkway lead to a central platform where flying machines and heavy bombers remain parked, left behind before the city was evacuated. Crazed leper gnomes now roam the flight decks, maintaining and guarding the idle war machines in place of skilled pilots.

Launch Bay also joins several parts of the complex. Ramps from its southeastern corridor descend into the Engineering Labs. On the lower deck, invading Dark Iron dwarves choke the southern passage. That tunnel offers a perilous route toward Tinkers' Court, deep in the city.
